description: Yearbook photograph of Georgia O'Keeffe from Canyon, Texas. Mounted on thick paper. Printed on recto: "Georgia O'Keeffe//Art." Handwritten on verso: "I like your hair-do//Ted." Two envelopes: handwritten on one, "Texas" and "Anonymous" on opposite side; handwritten on the second envelope, "Canyon Tex." with typed text "envelope #3" and list of 18 photographs previously enclosed in envelope. Flap of second envelope: "Georgia O'Keeffe - Abiquiu, New Mexico 87510" and "George O'Keeffe in Canyon Texas [sic]"
title: Georgia O'Keeffe yearbook picture from Canyon, Texas
